description: For appliance repair, this inspection checklist records diagnostic sequence, service-manual checks, parts, labor, customer authorization, food or property protection, and testing. Its supporting evidence includes fault codes, voltage or pressure readings, component condition, part numbers, photos, and post-repair cycle result.

Food, floors, cabinetry, and surrounding property are protected
Unresolved faults and safe-use limits are conspicuous
Customer guidance, parts warranty, and recurrence plan are documented

title: Appliance Repair Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during appliance repair diagnosis and service record when the appliance repair record must identify appliance type, make, model, serial, age, symptom, location, utilities, warranty, and prior repair. Complete the applicable handoff for repair outcome, replaced-part disposition, operational test, customer guidance, warranty, and recurrence follow-up.
